profiles.name: Eurolite LED ML-56 RGBW
profiles.notes: Transcribed from the Eurolite manual (v1.0, DMX protocol, 4-channel mode); matches OFL eurolite/led-ml-56-rgbw. Channel 4 is 'cool white'. The 4-channel mode has no dimmer, so intensity is virtual. The 6-channel mode (dimmer, strobe/sound) is not transcribed.

profiles.name: Chauvet DJ COLORband PiX
profiles.notes: Transcribed from the Chauvet DJ user manual Rev. 6 (36-CH personality: 12 zones of red, green and blue); matches OFL chauvet-dj/colorband-pix. No dimmer channel in this personality, so each cell is dimmed virtually. Other personalities are not transcribed.
